Who We Are

Trusted Concrete Manufacturers Since 1998

BKN Group of Industries is a leading manufacturer of RCC Spun Pipes (Hume Pipes), Underground Water Tanks, Concrete Electric Poles, Cement Bricks and Precast Concrete Products in Karnataka. Operating from our main unit at Kunigal since 1998 and our unit at Tiptur, we supply products manufactured as per IS 458 / IS 1678 specifications to contractors, government departments and gram panchayats across Tumkur, Hassan, Chikmagalur and Chitradurga districts.

Product 01

RCC Spun Pipes  /  Hume Pipes

Reinforced Cement Concrete spun pipes manufactured to IS 458 standards in NP2 and NP3 classes. Ideal for stormwater drainage, sewage lines, culverts, irrigation channels and road crossings. Available from 300mm up to 1600mm internal diameter at our Kunigal unit.

Underground Water Tanks

Strong, leak-proof RCC underground sump tanks for residential, commercial and agricultural use. Built to withstand ground pressure and last for decades — a durable alternative to plastic and masonry tanks.

Ideal For

Home water storage · Borewell sumps · Farm & irrigation storage · Apartment & commercial buildings · Rainwater harvesting
